business: SEGMENT: real estate agents, St. Louis
prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in St. Louis MO to sell my house?
competitors_mentioned: Mark Gellman and The Gellman Team
engine_stated_criteria: near yours and in your price range
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent—the right choice depends on your neighborhood, home price, and how much hands-on service you want. Based on the available recent rankings and seller-focused track records, **Mark Gellman and The Gellman Team** are one strong starting point: a local ranking reports extensive transaction experience and hundreds of reviews. **Heather Schulte** is another candidate, particularly for higher-priced homes: Homes.com reports 27 listing-side transactions in the past year, with listings ranging from $100,000 to $1.2 million.

Before choosing, interview two or three agents who have recently sold homes **near yours and in your price range**. Ask for their recent listing results, marketing plan, proposed list price and the evidence behind it, who will personally handle your sale, and their commission and contract terms. A high team sales count alone doesn’t guarantee the best fit.

If you share your neighborhood or ZIP code, approximate home value, and whether you prioritize speed or maximizing price, I can help narrow down what to look for.
